study_design: Retrospective case-control study using home interviews and quantitative dietary histories
reason: The abstract evaluates prostate cancer generally by age group but does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In the prostate cancer study, no effect was detected for total vitamin A or ascorbic acid in men less than 70 years old, but a direct association of vitamin A only with a dose-response gradient was found for men 70 years or older (odds ratio = 1.87; P less than .05, for the highest relative to the lowest intake quartile).
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported vitamin A odds ratio concerns prostate cancer generally among men aged 70 years or older, with no aggressive-disease definition.
